name: Basically FNF: Remix
desc:
basically Friday Night Funk, but again.
Make sure you play the real FNF (and its mods) if you can.

How to play: WASD or Arrow keys (can be changed in-game)

BFNF:R and its content is FREE, will always be FREE, and we have no intention of changing that.

Credits to MaplGalaxy and NeroBlack01 as the original creators of this game.
If there are any creators that would like their mod/song removed from the game, please reach out to one of our devs in the community server. Other ways of contact are also available.

credits to ninja_muffin99, kawaisprite, PhantomArcade3K, evilsk8r and all of the fnf mod community. I don't deserve an iota of credit.

Please make sure to report any bugs in our community server, under the Bug Reports forum.

Game Thumbnail by catsissta / @embersblaze

Have fun (and don't cheat!) :)

scripts.title: NIXI HUB | AUTO PLAY
scripts.features:
✨ [FEATURES] ✨

🎮 1. AutoPlay

🎯 Flawlessly hits arrows 🏹 and holds long notes 🎹 with zero lane-sticking 🚫 or freeze bugs! ❄️

👥 Player Side Detection: 🔄 Auto (reads active player slot from game data) 📊, ◀️ Side 1, or ▶️ Side 2.

⏱️ Accurate Judgment Modes:

💎 Perfect (<= 16.5 ms)

🟢 Sick (16.5 ms - 43.5 ms)

🟡 Good (43.5 ms - 76.5 ms)

🎭 2. Free Animations (Animation Changer): ✨

🔓 Unlock and play with ANY animation in the game for free without spending points 💸

(Shaggy 🥪, Sans 💀, Tricky 🤡, Camellia 🎧, Whitty 💣, Matt 🥊, Boyfriend 🎤, etc.)

📚 Dynamic Library: 📂 Automatically fetches all animations present in the game files.

🔒 Animation Lock: 🛡️ Prevents the game server from resetting your equipped custom animation.

👁️ 3. Visuals & Anti-Modcharts (Screen Protection): 🛡️

📳 Disable Camera Shake: 🎥 Hooks camera functions to completely eliminate screen vibrations.

🚫 Block Modcharts & Distractions: 🌀 Turns off camera sway and disorienting stage distractions.

🕶️ Remove Flashes & Blackouts: 💥 Neutralizes full-screen flashbangs, sudden blur spikes 🌫️, and black screen overlays ⬛.

🔭 Locked Custom FOV: 🎚️ Lock your Field of View with a custom slider.

🚀 One-Click FPS Boost: ⚡ Optimizes performance by removing shadows 👥, particles ✨, and hiding high-poly crowd NPCs 🚶‍♂️.

🌌 4. Teleports Tab: 📍

🏙️ Avenue Spawn: ⚡ Instant teleport back to the main lobby spawn.

🎬 Solo Theater: 🎭 Fast teleport to the Solo Mode stage.

🛒 Remix Outlet: 🛍️ Teleport directly into the shop.

🥚 Secret Easter Eggs: 🕵️‍♂️ Direct, safe teleports to map secrets (Mewo 🐱, Mano 🖐️, MaplSeesYou 🍁).

⚙️ 5. Miscellaneous & System: 💻

🌐 Bilingual Support: 🗣️ Full language selector modal upon launch (🇬🇧 English & 🇷🇺 Russian).

🛡️ Single-Instance Protection: 🧹 Re-injecting automatically purges previous windows.

💾 Obsidian Config System: 📁 Save and load custom configurations and themes anytime 🎨.

🔑 Integrated Key System: 🤖 Lightweight key check with automatic local saving 📲.

📖 [HOW TO USE] 🎮

1️⃣ 💉 Execute the script inside Basically FNF: Remix.

2️⃣ 🔑 Enter your key (click "Get Key" 🤖 to copy the bot link if needed).

3️⃣ 🌐 Select your preferred language (🇬🇧 English or 🇷🇺 Russian).

4️⃣ 🎉 Enjoy!
